name: Job Automation v3 - FastAPI Dorks + OpenRouter + Telegram

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS seen_jobs (
  job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT,
  company TEXT,
  url TEXT,
  sent_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  keywords: ['devops', 'kubernetes', 'terraform', 'aws', 'python', 'golang', 'fastapi', 'backend engineer', 'platform engineer', 'full stack engineer'],
  job_sites: ['linkedin.com/jobs', 'indeed.com/jobs', 'weworkremotely.com', 'remotive.com', 'wellfound.com', 'greenhouse.io', 'lever.co', 'workable.com', 'jobs.ashbyhq.com', 'jobicy.com'],
  location: 'remote',
  countries: ['egypt', 'mena', 'eu', 'usa', 'canada'],
  job_type: 'full-time',
  experience: null,
  days_back: 1,
  recent_hours: 24,
  posted_today: false,
  strict_recent: true,
  sort_by_posted_at: true,
  max_results: 60,
  reset_cache: false
} }}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS seen_count,
  '{{ String($json.id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS id,
  '{{ String($json.title || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS title,
  '{{ String($json.company || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS company,
  '{{ String($json.url || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS url,
  '{{ String($json.description || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS description,
  '{{ String($json.location || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS location,
  '{{ String($json.salary || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS salary,
  '{{ String($json.source || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS source,
  '{{ String($json.dork_query || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS dork_query,
  '{{ String($json.posted_at || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS posted_at,
  {{ Number($json.score || 0) }} AS score
FROM seen_jobs
WHERE job_id = '{{ String($json.id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}';

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO seen_jobs (job_id, title, company, url)
VALUES (
  '{{ String($json.id || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.title || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.company || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ String($json.url || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
);
